svg.title: Heartkettle

text.font-family: Fredoka, 'Baloo 2', Nunito, 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif

svg.text: Every fort runs on one, with 300 HP, bosses too. Copper body, brass bands, a teal glow you can always see through walls.

text.font-family: Fredoka, 'Baloo 2', Nunito, 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif
Fredoka, 'Baloo 2', Nunito, 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif

svg.text: Clean copper, steady glow, slow wisp.

text.font-family: Fredoka, 'Baloo 2', Nunito, 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif
Fredoka, 'Baloo 2', Nunito, 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif

svg.text: One crack across the belly. Thin steam.

text.font-family: Fredoka, 'Baloo 2', Nunito, 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif
Fredoka, 'Baloo 2', Nunito, 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif

svg.text: Crack web. Lid rattles. Steam in pulses.

text.font-family: Fredoka, 'Baloo 2', Nunito, 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif
Fredoka, 'Baloo 2', Nunito, 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif

svg.text: Lid off. The fort sits down.

text.font-family: Fredoka, 'Baloo 2', Nunito, 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif

svg.text: Glow through walls (both forts, all the time)

text.font-family: Fredoka, 'Baloo 2', Nunito, 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif

svg.text: Sits in a 2 x 2 Kettle Room, one block in from every face.
Sprite: 30 x 30 cells, drawn at 64 and 128 px.
States swap at 50% and 25%, the same marks as the HUD gauge,
the whistle and the music. The copper never turns red or orange.
Glow colour #4FE3C1 is reserved: only the kettle
and Steam use it. No shell may glow teal.
